providerPolicy.externalNodePolicy: All exact provider-declared citing/cited works become nodes; the graph is not restricted to the 68 seeds.
providerPolicy.failurePolicy: Every unresolved seed, failed page, remaining cursor/offset, count mismatch, provider cap, or circuit-open direction stays explicit; no failure is converted to an empty page.
providerPolicy.mergePolicy: Exact provider IDs and exact DOI/arXiv identifiers only; title-only merging is forbidden.
providerPolicy.rawStorage: Exact response bytes are stored under ignored private_data and referenced by SHA-256.
providerPolicy.secretPolicy: Public URLs remove api_key/key/mailto and public metadata records only credential presence.
providerPolicy.xpacPolicy: Use official OpenAlex is_xpac when returned; otherwise derive membership via include_xpac=true versus include_xpac=false. XPAC is not a relevance taxonomy.

crossref.candidateBoundary: A deposited DOI reference is an exact-ID candidate/support assertion; title-only references are not merged and deposited counts are not treated as complete bibliographies.
crossref.scope: Persistent-ID DOI seeds only; arXiv aliases are intentionally excluded.

openalex.listRequestBudgetBoundary: OpenAlex documentation reports $0.01/day anonymous usage versus $1/day with a free key; no key was present for this run.

xpac.classification: explicit is_xpac when returned; otherwise include_xpac set difference

semanticScholar.publicBoundary: Tracked outputs expose only S2 provider IDs, support/count flags, and attribution. Any seed title in this retrieval ledger is copied from frozen corpus truth, not S2; S2-only title/year text and full response payloads remain private/ignored.
